name: tetris-versus
description: 双人对战俄罗斯方块（共享引擎 + WebSocket 服务端 + Electron 客户端）

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run rebuild:engine && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @tetris/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tetris/server && npm run typecheck -w @tetris/client
scripts.release:win: npm run build:client && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ npm run dist:win -w @tetris/client
scripts.release:win:portable: npm run build:client && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ npm run dist:win:portable -w @tetris/client
scripts.release:mac: npm run build:client && npm run dist:mac -w @tetris/client
